_doc: Copy to config/voice.json and tune. This is the realtor's writing fingerprint -- every post and email is drafted against it. The richest version is mined from the realtor's own outgoing messages and written up in docs/voice/realtor-profile.md at the host repo root; this file is the short form the copy step actually loads.

voice_rules.voice: Warm, direct, authentic. Writes like a competent friend who happens to know real estate, not a brochure. Proper capitalization, generous whitespace, zero corporate fluff.
signature_phrases_by_frequency: Replace these with the realtor's actual high-frequency phrases, most common first.
Mine them from real outgoing texts/emails so the list reflects how she genuinely writes.
Keep 6-10. Anything rarer reads as a tic when it lands in every post.
do_not_use_in_writing: Phrases the realtor says out loud but never writes. Spoken tics do not survive on the page.
Anything a competitor's listing post would also say.
emoji_rules: Name the one or two emoji the realtor actually uses, and the ones she never uses.
If she does not use emoji, say so here and the copy step will drop them.
hard_rules: NO em dashes. Ever. Use a comma, period, or a blank line instead.
NO AI cliches: 'nestled', 'oasis', 'stunning', 'dream home', 'this one wont last', 'dont miss out', 'act fast'.
NO sycophancy, no 'Im so happy to share'.
Line breaks between beats. Multi-paragraph, not a wall of text.
Price belongs in the body of the launch post, not just on the graphic.
Leave minor typos / autocorrect feel, do not over-polish.
voice_rules.source_of_truth: docs/voice/realtor-profile.md -- read before drafting if unsure.

mix: 2-3 local tags: the realtor's market plus the specific town of the listing
2-3 lifestyle tags tied to unique_features / recreational_feature (#waterfront, #acreage, #riverfront, #mountainviews, etc.)
